cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've postponed dinner again. You still hate disappointing me.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're protecting my Fridays now. I'll leave the date open; we're already looking after each other.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.
